features.name: Achath
features.fullDescription: Circa 1800. S. part single-storey and attic pinned boulder rubble 2-window and centre door frontage, centre projects with rectangular fanlight to door and oeil-de-boeuf window over. Original staircase and a little decorative plasterwork. Canted dormers and back wing later.
